title: Chart
description: A band's chord chart split into sections by a segmented control. The ink pill is a second copy of the tab row clipped to the selection, so the labels swap colour exactly at its edge. Click a section, or grab the pill and drag or flick it across the rail. Wherever you let go, it snaps to the nearest section.
intent: A clip-path pill whose colour swap is exact, held and thrown by hand
